text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus leaves her mark across every 
race of the Triple Tiara. Immediately 
following the Shuka Sho, she is 
interviewed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She explained that she conquered the 
grueling Triple Tiara through thorough 
"management." Her words brought renewed 
public attention to the importance of 
structured self-management.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a meeting to decide the next goal, 
Ikuno Dictus proposes running in the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown, as well as the 
"Yasuda Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A brutal racing rotation. Yet that is 
precisely why, if she can push through it, 
we can prove the importance of 
"management" to the world once more. It 
will lead to the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A future where every Umamusume can run 
with all their might for a long time 
without getting injured. As the first step 
toward that future, she now takes on the 
Osaka Hai.
